subject: MAP: Delta Tech procurement onboarding — Ariba/Coupa steps & target close
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@deltatech.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@deltatech.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-call recap + MAP (vendor onboarding milestones)

Hi Alex / Delta Procurement team —

Thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and a draft MAP focused on the vendor onboarding milestones so we can hit the proposed pilot go-live. I attached a short MAP_Draft and a blank vendor form for your intake team.

Summary of what we discussed (high level):
- Pilot scope: Redwood inference hosted API for internal analytics pipelines (non-PII)
- Target start: week of 8/23 (pilot data load 8/25) — target close for procurement: 2026-08-20
- Key dependencies: Ariba/Coupa supplier record, completed W-9, bank remit letter for ACH, PO & billing contact established

Proposed MAP milestones (owner / target / dependency):
1) Supplier enrollment submitted (Delta procurement) / 2026-08-05 / needs: Vendor legal name, remit address
2) W-9 & banking docs uploaded (Delta vendor admin) / 2026-08-09 / needs: PDF W-9, bank letter
3) Contract countersign (Redwood + Delta) / 2026-08-12 / needs: final SOW and approved T&Cs
4) PO issued / 2026-08-17 / depends on procurement approval
5) Pilot go-live (verify connectivity + invoice test) / 2026-08-25

Ask / next steps:
- Alex: please confirm who will submit the supplier enrollment (person + email) and whether you prefer Ariba or Coupa as canonical.
- Procurement: can you confirm required file formats for the vendor record upload and whether ACH remit requires a separate bank letter?
- Sergio / Priyom: I’ll update the MAP spreadsheet as we get confirmations and will circulate a final version for signature.

Attachments: MAP_Draft_DeltaTech.xlsx (draft), DeltaTech_VendorForm.xlsx (blank)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP (vendor onboarding milestones)

Vanessa — thanks for the rundown and the MAP draft. Quick answers:
- Procurement will submit the supplier enrollment; I'll loop Sarah Li (procurement ops) who manages Ariba/Coupa uploads.
- We typically use Ariba for third-party suppliers; Coupa is used for certain business units. For this pilot we'll go Ariba.
- Required: W-9 PDF, signed vendor form, remit-to banking letter (signed by bank).

Sarah — I’m adding you on-thread. Can we get an Ariba invite for Redwood and confirm the exact field list?

On timing: 8/20 target for procurement sign-off is aggressive but possible if we get the docs this week. I can escalate on our side.

—Alex

Hi Vanessa / Alex —

Thanks for the details. Per internal vendor intake, please upload the following to our Ariba supplier onboarding portal:
- Completed vendor profile (legal name, tax ID / EIN, remittance address)
- PDF W-9 (signed)
- Bank letter for ACH (on bank letterhead, dated within 90 days)
- Vendor contact for billing (name/email/phone)

Upload link: https://ariba.deltatech.com/supplier-portal/invite/ABCD1234
Template bank letter attached: Delta_Bank_Letter_Template.docx (please populate & return as signed by bank).

Notes / timings: once we receive all docs and the vendor profile is approved, we can generate a supplier code and push to Coupa for PO processing. Typical turnaround is 5 business days after complete submission. If you need faster processing, please let us know and we can request expedited review (requires approval from procurement director).

Regards,
Delta Tech Procurement
